fx_usd_idr.note: ADRO's FS state the closing rate only as 'Rupiah 10,000 = US$0.xx' and say it is the Bank Indonesia middle rate; the BI middle rate itself is stored. Bank Indonesia middle rate (kurs tengah) for 2020-12-31: BI publishes kurs beli 14,034.48 and kurs jual 14,175.53; their mean is 14,105.005, i.e. Rp14,105 (BI sets beli/jual at the mid rate -/+0.5% rounded to 2 dp). The FS policy (Note 2e) translates balances at 'the Bank of Indonesia's middle exchange rates prevailing at the reporting date', but prints the rate only inverted and rounded, 'Rupiah/US$1 0,000071' (https://www.medcoenergi.com/uploads/rwocis/423/medc-fy20.pdf PDF p. 39); no IDR-per-USD figure is printed in the FS or AR.

validation_ack.reason: Real gap. The FY2023 payout of 48.74% (AGMS 15 May 2024) covers only the US$400m interim + US$400m final. The EGMS of 18 Nov 2024 then approved a US$2,629.396m 'additional final cash dividend for 2023' out of retained earnings at 31 Dec 2023 (Rp1,358.18/share, ex 28 Nov 2024), which funded shareholders' purchase of the AADI shares in the POES. FY2023 dividend records therefore total US$3,429.4m vs profit x payout US$800m. Sources: AGMS 2024 summary minutes [https://www.alamtri.com/files/news/berkas_eng/2259/Ringkasan%20Risalah%20RUPST%202024%20-%20English.pdf], EGMS summary minutes [https://www.alamtri.com/files/news/berkas_eng/2307/ADRO-Ringkasan%20Risalah%20RUPSLB%20181124-English.pdf], FS2024 Note 27 PDF p. 127.

research_notes: Identity: PT Alamtri Resources Indonesia Tbk (ticker ADRO), formerly PT Adaro Energy Tbk (to Feb 2022: EGMS 9 Feb 2022 renamed it PT Adaro Energy Indonesia Tbk) and PT Adaro Energy Indonesia Tbk (renamed by the EGMS of 18 Nov 2024, second agenda). IR site moved from adaro.com to alamtri.com; document paths are unchanged (www.adaro.com/files/news/... = www.alamtri.com/files/news/...). Reporting/functional currency US$; all money in US$ million (FS print US$ thousands; divided by 1,000).

Business after the spin-off (subsector 'coal'): AlamTri keeps metallurgical coal through PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR, formerly PT Adaro Minerals Indonesia Tbk; 'Enviromet' hard coking coal, 7.41 Mt produced in 2025), mining contracting (SIS), and 'green' projects - the ~500,000 t/yr aluminium smelter of its subsidiary (commissioning started end-2025) and hydropower/renewables. The thermal-coal business (PT Adaro Indonesia, Envirocoal) went to PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI). Revenue mix is still overwhelmingly metallurgical coal, so 'coal' remains the right subsector; reviewers may want a note on the page that this is met coal, not thermal coal, from FY2024.

AADI spin-off mechanics (FS2024 Note 40, POES prospectus [https://www.alamtri.com/files/news/berkas_eng/2309/Prospektus%20PUPS%20Alamtri.pdf], final-price disclosure [https://www.alamtri.com/files/news/berkas_eng/2311/Keterbukaan%20Informasi%20Harga%20Final%20PUPS_english.pdf], EGMS minutes 18 Oct and 18 Nov 2024): AADI (formerly PT Alam Tri Abadi, 99.9999% owned by ADRO) did an IPO of new shares on 5 Dec 2024 (ADRO's stake diluted to ~90%; ADRO's CF shows US$272.2m 'receipts from subsidiary's IPO'), and ADRO sold 5,811,178,298 AADI shares (74.63% of AADI's issued shares, i.e. 82.9% of the 7,008,202,240 shares offered - not every right was exercised) to its own shareholders through a Public Offering by Existing Shareholders (POES/PUPS, POJK 76/2017) on 9-11 Dec 2024. ADRO holders on the 29 Nov 2024 record date received NON-TRANSFERABLE purchase rights: 1,000 rights per 4,389 ADRO shares, each right buying 1 AADI share at Rp5,960 (107.5% of the appraised value; AADI's listing-day VWAP was Rp6,560). ADRO lost control on 9 Dec 2024, received US$2,181.0m cash, booked a US$68.7m loss to APIC and US$26.4m to other expenses, and keeps 15.37% of AADI as an FVOCI investment (US$449.0m retained interest).

The cash for that purchase came from the US$2,629.396m 'additional final cash dividend for 2023' = Rp1,358.18 per ADRO share (EGMS 18 Nov 2024; regular-market cum 26 Nov, EX 28 Nov 2024, record 29 Nov, paid 6 Dec 2024). The POES purchase-right entitlement had the SAME cum/ex/record dates (POES schedule disclosure 22 Nov 2024 [https://www.alamtri.com/files/news/berkas_eng/2308/Informasi%20Indikasi%20Jadwal%20PUPS%20-%20English.pdf]: cum 26 Nov, ex 28 Nov 2024 regular market, record 29 Nov). 1,000/4,389 x Rp5,960 = Rp1,357.9 per ADRO share, i.e. the dividend exactly funds full take-up. Economically this is a spin-off; legally it is a cash dividend plus a non-transferable right to buy AADI shares. No shares were distributed in kind and there was no split, bonus or rights issue of ADRO shares, so NOTHING goes into corporate_actions.json.

Price-fetcher check (2026-11-03, Yahoo chart API, used only to see what the fetcher will receive, not as a data source): Yahoo lists NO split events for ADRO.JK, so the fetcher's split reconciliation passes with an empty corporate-action list. Yahoo treats 28 Nov 2024 as an ordinary cash dividend of 1,358.18 (no price scaling of the chart closes). The traded price fell in two limit-down sessions - close 3,670 (26 Nov 2024; 27 Nov was a holiday) -> 2,760 (28 Nov, -24.8%) -> 2,080 (29 Nov, -24.6%) - so the validator's 35% one-session check does not fire, but anyone building a continuous price series should treat 2024-11-28 as a ~Rp1,358 cash distribution (about 37% of the cum price), not as a crash. Yahoo's year-end closes 2020-2025 equal the AR prices stored here.

Presentation of the spun-off business: FY2024 FS (and FY2025 FS comparatives) present AADI as a discontinued operation under PSAK 58 (SFAS 105 in the AR's wording): income statement = continuing operations + one line 'profit from discontinued operations' (918.648 incl. a 26.4 reclassification loss; 810.133 attributable). FY2023 income statement is re-presented in FS2024 (continuing revenue 2,135.412, operating income 764.935, continuing attributable profit 578.129, discontinued 1,063.308); the 2023 balance sheet and the cash-flow statements are NOT restated (the 2024 cash-flow statement includes AADI to 9 Dec 2024; AADI's cash at deconsolidation 1,681.054 is a separate line).

Series policy (READ BEFORE CHARTING): FY2020-FY2023 revenue, operating profit, EBITDA, production and sales are the whole group AS ORIGINALLY REPORTED (thermal + met coal). FY2024 and FY2025 revenue, operating profit, EBITDA, production and sales are CONTINUING operations only (met coal etc.). So FY2023 -> FY2024 revenue (6,517.6 -> 2,078.7) and production (65.88 -> 6.63 Mt) are a structural break, not a collapse. FY2024 net_profit_attr (1,380.0) and EPS (0.04491) are TOTAL incl. the discontinued AADI part; continuing-only were 569.9 and 0.01855. FY2024 cfo and capex include AADI to 9 Dec 2024. Balance-sheet items are as at each year end (post-spin-off from FY2024). Re-presented FY2023 continuing figures are given in the FY2023 notes.

EBITDA definition drift: AR2020-AR2024 report 'operational EBITDA' (EBITDA excluding prior-year tax assessments, decommissioning-provision changes and, from AR2023, allowances, derivative losses and impairments). AR2025 switched to plain 'EBITDA' (profit excl. D&A, tax, finance cost/income and forex) and restates FY2024 to 986 (vs 982.3 operational) and FY2023 continuing to 1,055 (vs 1,057). Each year stores the figure first reported for it. The FS never present EBITDA, so the 9M interim EBITDA is null.

Dividends: all declared in US$ and paid in rupiah at the BI middle rate of the record date (EGMS date for the Nov-2024 special); dps = rupiah per share as paid, total = US$ million. FY2020: final only (US$146.8m, 99.92%) - no 2020 interim. FY2021: 350 interim + 300 final. FY2022: 500 + 500. FY2023: 400 + 400 + the 2,629.4 special. FY2024: 200 + 300 (36.23% of total profit incl. discontinued). FY2025: 250 + 197.5 (99.96%). The IR dividend page's per-share column mixes interim/final amounts (e.g. FY2023 US$0.01300 = final only) and is not used. FY2022 interim rupiah DPS is from KSEI (the company's own Jan-2023 FX notice is not on its website).

fx_usd_idr: the FS print the BI closing rate only as 'Rupiah 10,000 = US$0.xx' (two decimals), which is too coarse to store. For FY2022-FY2025 and 9M2026 the stored value is DERIVED from the FS's own foreign-currency note (net Rupiah monetary position in Rp'000 / its printed US$ equivalent), where every Rupiah line gives the same rate to 0.1 rupiah (15,731 / 15,416 / 16,162 / 16,782 / 17,998). FY2020 and FY2021 are null because the lines of those notes imply different rates (14,105-14,228 and 14,269-14,294). A reviewer may prefer null for all years (golden rule: not printed) - the derivation is in each note so it is easy to revert.

Share count: buybacks 2021-2025 and two capital reductions by cancelling treasury shares (2024 AGMS: 1,227,296,100 shares, issued 31,985,962,000 -> 30,758,665,900; 2025 AGMS: 1,368,976,500 shares -> 29,389,689,400; 2026 AGMS: the remaining 589,195,200 -> 28,800,494,200). These are not splits/bonus/rights and are not schema corporate actions; shares_out is net of treasury shares at each year end. Basic EPS uses weighted-average shares, which explains EPS x year-end shares differing from profit by up to ~2% in 2021, 2024 and 2025 (within tolerance).

No stock split, reverse split, bonus issue or rights issue of ADRO shares since 2019 (checked: ARs 2020-2025 share-information sections and the OJK checklist, the IR shareholder-information page, FS share-capital notes). The only rights issue on the website is the 2008-era 'Adaro Rights Issue' document and a 2016 rights issue of the subsidiary PT Adaro Indonesia, both before 2019. corporate_actions is therefore empty.

Doubts / typos found in sources (not used): AR2020 text p. 246 says the 2020 close was Rp1,445 (share table and AR2021 say 1,430). The FY2025 interim schedule notice says 'US$250,000,000 (two hundred million ...)' in words. The 2024 AGMS minutes print the cash-market ex date as 'May 30, 2023' (2024 meant). FY2022 final payment date: AGMS schedule 6 Jun 2023 vs FS 'paid on 5 June 2023' (6 Jun stored). AR2024's highlight footnotes 1 and 2 (core earnings vs operational EBITDA definitions) are swapped. The FY2020 comparatives were restated slightly in FS2021 (CFO 736.431 -> 738.753; current assets 1,731.619 -> 1,731.867); original values stored.

REVIEWER 2026-11-03: fx_usd_idr FY2020-FY2025 replaced by the Bank Indonesia middle rate (official BI web service, the rate the FS say they use); the agent's derived FY2022-FY2025 values were identical, FY2020-FY2021 had been null because the FS's 2-decimal rate is too coarse. The 9M 2026 interim rate stays the derived 17,998 (the FS's own Rupiah lines all translate at it).
